decisions.decision: Build independently implemented FiveM-style RP features; do not claim an iOS port of official FiveM.exe or server protocol compatibility without a tested implementation.
Use GitHub repository + state.json + PR/issue history as source of truth between conversations; chat memory is supplemental.
Reverse engineering produces inventories, interfaces, symbols and reconstructed pseudocode; cannot guarantee recovery of original source code from IPA.
Automated writes are kept in feature branches and draft PRs. No unattended main merge, IPA release, or publication of commercial game assets.
